item.title: Moonforge at All Systems Go! 2026
item.description:
All Systems Go! is a conference focused on foundational user-space Linux technologies. Various contributors and users of foundational projects in modern Linux systems attend to present and discover new functionality in various areas.

We are going to present our work on Moonforge on Wednesday, September 30. We’ll cover the goals behind Moonforge, how we are aiming to achieve them, our latest work on creating an easy to use CLI and a few more things. If you are attending the All Systems Go! make sure you don’t miss our presentation.
